The RFP requires **at least five years of an established, live track record** managing the proposed emerging-markets equity strategy. Qualified women-, minority-, or disabled-owned businesses are exempt from that minimum, subject to SURS’s discretion.

It **prefers** a firm with either **at least two existing U.S. public pension fund clients**, each with more than $1 billion in total plan assets, **or one existing public-plan client** with more than $10 billion in total plan assets. 【SURS_Illinois__SURS-Investment-Manager-RFP-Template.pdf, pp. 5–6】
